description: Audit one Google Maps business listing. Provide its business name and city/state/country; do not pass a website URL or domain. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

business_name.description: Business name as shown in its Google Maps listing, not a website domain or URL. Type: String. Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Business city, state/region and country as a human-readable place name, for example Austin, Texas, United States. Type: String. Required.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

name: agentseo_local_audit
title: AgentSEO Local Audit
